Jordan / Sophie - thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps related to the MAP milestone for legal review so we have alignment on who owns what and expected turnaround times.

- Redwood response: Redwood legal will review consolidated redlines and provide either (1) agreed tracked version or (2) counter-redlines within 48 business hours of receiving a single consolidated redline file.

- Target close date for legal milestone: 2026-03-18 (we agreed to aim for this to keep the commercial close on schedule).
- Dependencies: Procurement (PO/contract signature), security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) - security artifacts requested in parallel; see MAP task IDs.

Attachments: I attached the current MAP draft and a copy of Redwood's standard MSA for reference. Please confirm who will take the first pass on tracked changes (your counsel vs. we send a clean copy for you to redline). If Acme prefers, Redwood legal can accept redlines in PDF/Docx with track changes; we strongly prefer a single consolidated file so we can turn around quickly.

Next steps:
1) Jordan/Sophie to confirm whether Acme legal will send consolidated redlines by 2026-03-09.
2) If yes, Redwood legal (Vivek) will commit to a 48-business-hour turnaround for the first response.
3) Any high-priority exceptions flagged will be calendared for a short decision call (if needed) the week of 2026-03-15.
